main_text.p: ta, codicem enim illum edere, nunquam mihi proposui. An cum Hebraico-Sama-ritano ad amussim consentiat, & verbum de verbo sit redditum, scire tantùm avebam, quod ex 4 aut 5 capitibus facile de-prehenditur ; officiosæ tuæ amicitiæ quod rependam;quamquam res nihili præ manibus jam versabam : me liberius te-cum colloquentem tantisper sustine, Ex-odi 3[?] ver. 15 Hoc nomen mihi est in æter-num, Hebr. scribitur לעלם cum defectu Vau, adesse enim ex Mosse deberet, ut ibi notant Masorethæ. R. S. Jarki in istum locum & cæteri Hebræi hinc colligunt, nomen יהוה aliter legi, aliter scribi o-portere, eò quòd עלם abscondere signifi-cet, ideoque nomen istud à Deo datum ut abscondatur ; sed codex Samaritanus habet plene & perfecte לעולם. In sequenti mysterio vix risum continere possis, Ge-nef. 1. ver. 14. fiant luminaria . מארת[?], Vau similiter rationem reddit Jarki, quia eo die, qui est quartus, infantibus an-gina quædam contingere solet, atque i-deo jejunium quartæ feriæ institutum esse. page.notes: The text runs straight through; no paragraph breaks are visible. Its first word "ta," is a fragment carried over from page 157. Doubtful readings: "Exodi 3" is set in italic with the "Ex-" hyphen at the line end; the "3" and "odi" are hard to read, so marked [?]. The Hebrew of "לעלם" (line 11, defective spelling without Vav) and "מארת" (line 20) is read from a low-resolution image and is marked or to be checked. "rependam;quamquam" is printed with the semicolon and no space. Light speckle and stains in the left margin are not printed text and are omitted. The running head "MORINUS ALEANDRO." is set in small capitals.
